name: voz
description: Opt-in voice mode: each reply ends with a spoken summary made by a cheap model and macOS say.

interface.shortDescription: Spoken summaries of replies, off until you ask.
interface.longDescription: Ask Codex to turn voice mode on. Each reply then ends with an audio summary written by gpt-6-luna and read by macOS say. Audio is stored in ~/.local/share/voz and deleted after 14 days.
defaultPrompt: Use voz to turn voice mode on.
Use voz to turn voice mode off.
